description: This file contains business logic functions for managing checkout address selection, creation, and order updates in a Django e-commerce application. It includes data classes, helper functions for address validation and creation, and core functions to apply checkout form data to an order and retrieve default address context.

classes.name: AddressSelectionResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an address resolution attempt, including order info and optional addresses or error message.

methods.name: bool _is_valid_form(values)
methods.description: Internal helper to validate address form fields, ensuring none are empty.

methods.name: Optional[Address] _get_default_address(*, user: get_user_model(), address_type: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the default address of a specified type for a given user.

methods.name: Address _create_address_from_form( *, user: get_user_model(), address_type: str, street_address: str, apartment_address: str, country, zip_code: str, set_default: bool, )
methods.description: Creates and saves a new Address instance from form data, setting default if specified.

methods.name: AddressSelectionResult apply_checkout_form_to_order(*, user: get_user_model(), order: Order, form)
methods.description: Main function that applies checkout form data to update the order's shipping and billing addresses, returning success or error info.

methods.name: dict get_default_addresses_context(*, user: get_user_model())
methods.description: Retrieves default shipping and billing addresses for the user to provide in context.

ctags.name: _create_address_from_form
ctags.signature: ( *, user: get_user_model(), address_type: str, street_address: str, apartment_address: str, country, zip_code: str, set_default: bool, )

ctags.name: apply_checkout_form_to_order
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_checkout_form_to_order(*, user: get_user_model(), order: Order, form) -> AddressSelect/
